label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: y el turbante de lino fino, y los adornos de las tiaras de lino fino, y los calzones del lino, lino fino retorcido,
spanish: y el turbante de lino fino, y los tocados de los gorros, de lino fino, y los calzones del lino, lino fino retorcido,

units.es: y el turbante de lino fino
y los tocados de los gorros, de lino fino
y los calzones del lino, lino fino retorcido

grammarChanges: Replaced «adornos» with «tocados» for h02039028005 (masc. pl. construct) so the Spanish names a head-dress, not generic decoration.
Replaced «tiaras» with «gorros» for h02039028006 (def. fem. pl. absolute) so the Spanish names a cap/bonnet, not a crown or diadem.

Inserted a comma before «de lino fino» so the material phrase reads as apposition to the whole headdress clause rather than binding narrowly to «los gorros», matching the comma pattern already used in the breeches clause (lino, lino fino retorcido).
readerNote: Added a comma before 'de lino fino' so the fine-linen material describes the headdresses-of-caps phrase as a whole, the same appositional pattern already used for the breeches clause, rather than appearing to bind only to 'los gorros'.
